```{r}
#| label: setup

# Improve digit display and NA display for kable tables
options(scipen = 1, knitr.kable.NA = "")

# Load necessary packages
library(tidyverse)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)
library(quantmod)
library(ggplot2)
```

```{r}
microsoft_stock <- getSymbols("MSFT", src = "yahoo", from = "2025-03-01", to = "2026-11-01") |>
  data.frame(Date = index(MSFT), coredata(MSFT)) |>
  select(Date, MSFT.Close) |>
  rename(Close = MSFT.Close) |>
  mutate(COMP = "MSFT")

alphabet_stock <- getSymbols("GOOG", src = "yahoo", from = "2025-03-01", to = "2026-11-01") |>
  data.frame(Date = index(GOOG), coredata(GOOG)) |>
  select(Date, GOOG.Close) |>
  rename(Close = GOOG.Close) |>
  mutate(COMP = "GOOG")

meta_stock <- getSymbols("META", src = "yahoo", from = "2025-03-01", to = "2026-11-01") |>
  data.frame(Date = index(META), coredata(META)) |>
  select(Date, META.Close) |>
  rename(Close = META.Close) |>
  mutate(COMP = "META")

apple_stock <- getSymbols("AAPL", src = "yahoo", from = "2025-03-01", to = "2026-11-01") |>
  data.frame(Date = index(AAPL), coredata(AAPL)) |>
  select(Date, AAPL.Close) |>
  rename(Close = AAPL.Close) |>
  mutate(COMP = "AAPL")

nvidia_stock <- getSymbols("NVDA", src = "yahoo", from = "2025-03-01", to = "2026-11-01") |>
  data.frame(Date = index(NVDA), coredata(NVDA)) |>
  select(Date, NVDA.Close) |>
  rename(Close = NVDA.Close) |>
  mutate(COMP = "NVDA")

tesla_stock <- getSymbols("TSLA", src = "yahoo", from = "2025-03-01", to = "2026-11-01") |>
  data.frame(Date = index(TSLA), coredata(TSLA)) |>
  select(Date, TSLA.Close) |>   
  rename(Close = TSLA.Close) |>
  mutate(COMP = "TSLA")

stock_price_joined <- bind_rows(microsoft_stock, alphabet_stock, meta_stock, apple_stock, nvidia_stock, tesla_stock)

ten_qs <- read_csv("data/scraped-10qs.csv")
```
```{r}
##microsoft

# Convert dates to Date format
tenq <- ten_qs |>
  mutate(`FIL-D` = as.Date(`FIL-D`))|>
  mutate(COMP = recode(COMP,
    "Microsoft" = "MSFT",
    "Google" = "GOOG",
    "Meta" = "META",
    "Apple" = "AAPL",
    "Nvidia" = "NVDA",
    "Tesla" = "TSLA"
  ))



class(tenq$`FIL-D`)
class(stock_price_joined$Date)

```


```{r}

stock_before <- stock_price_joined |>
  rename(
    stock_date_before = Date,
    stock_price_before = Close
  )

before <- tenq |>
  left_join(
    stock_before,
    by = join_by(
      COMP,
      closest(`FIL-D` > stock_date_before)
    )
  )


stock_after <- stock_price_joined |>
  rename(
    stock_date_after = Date,
    stock_price_after = Close
  )

final_data <- before |>
  left_join(
    stock_after,
    by = join_by(
      COMP,
      closest(`FIL-D` < stock_date_after)
    )
  )
```
